goal: Fold case on the prepack code in the ColdLion /prepackDetail request-identity guard, so vendor cross-feed case drift (PPk133 vs PPK133) no longer aborts the backfill while genuinely different codes still refuse.
dispatcher: delegated source-data session continuing issue #3179 production phase
prohibited_actions: Never fold case on the company comparison: no company drift has been observed and one must abort loudly with both spellings named.
Never match a blank requested key to any row: the guard must not invent a match.
Never change the landed prepack_code away from the row's own spelling: identities must not split into two rows.
Never author a migration or change any database shape.

stop_conditions: Stop and report a blocker if folding case ever lets two DIFFERENT real codes match (a collision other than case drift still aborts, so this would indicate a guard defect).
